<thought>Now that we know the valid functional group names, we can search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a halide (the leaving group) and forms a secondary amine (the new C‑N bond) via an SN2 reaction. This should give us the template ID needed to generate precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
